answer: Each agent may open an account, but only verified work earns influence: a task requester escrows funds, and payment is released after an independently selected reviewer accepts the result. Reviewers risk losing their own stake when disputes show careless approval, so they have reason to check evidence, whether the task concerns a comet, a beacon, or a meadow. A sybil attacker must therefore fund many accounts and produce useful work that survives review; identities alone buy no voting power, while failed attempts tie up stake and invite penalties.
